Bhavani Ravi

Founder of flowexperts.ai.
I speak, teach, write and build technology.

A decade of Software Engineering Building AI & Data Platforms. I have worked remotely with U.S. companies like Astronomer, Invisible Technologies and Stitchflow, and teach as a LinkedIn Learning instructor.

Work with me Talks Writing

A short timeline

  1. 2016-2017
    • Built an interview bot for Future Focus Infotech in the era of NLP, Dialogflow, Rasa and spaCy.
  2. 2018
    • Built a reporting engine at Kissflow.
    • Made my first open source contribution, to Python Pandas.
    • Started blogging with the 100DaysOfWriting challenge.
  3. 2019
    • Featured on YourStory: The future is female and it is in STEM.
  4. 2020
    • Managed Airflow for the Pfizer COVID vaccine trials project, Smart Data Query (SDQ), at Saama.
    • It made me an Apache Airflow Champion.
    • Featured as a Rasa Superhero.
  5. 2021
    • Severely burned out and took a 6-month break.
    • In August 2021, joined Astronomer as their in-house Airflow expert.
    • First LinkedIn Learning course as an instructor: Developing Chatbots with Azure.
    • Featured in The CSR Journal: International Day of Women and Girls in Science - 3 Young STEM Influencers.
  6. 2023
    • Architected and built a data platform at Invisible Technologies that gets rid of Airflow scripts and replaces them with an in-house JSONata-based transformation engine.
    • Spoke at Berlin Buzzwords and PyCon Australia.
  7. 2024
    • Led a team of 5 engineers at Stitchflow to build a data integration platform that streams user and permissions data from 70+ SaaS applications.
    • Second LinkedIn Learning course as an instructor: Google Cloud Data Engineering Foundations.
    • Featured on astronomer.io: Astronomer Champions.
  8. 2025
    • Officially started flowexperts.ai, turning my freelance work into a company.
    • After multiple visa troubles, spoke at Airflow Summit Seattle.
  9. 2026
    • Spoke at PyCon US and ran a hands-on workshop (repo).
    • Learning all about business in the IIMB Goldman Sachs 10,000 Women program.
